fact: APS reports that Senegalese startup Andakia presented Allo Goor Gi, an AI platform answering pupils' questions by phone call in Wolof and French without internet, built with the Ministry of National Education and hosted on servers in Senegal, according to its designer.
RTS says works began on 5 October 2026 on a locally run AI application for court archives, with an NVIDIA DGX Spark delivered, funded with UNDP and Korean support.
